note: Dated leaderboard rank for every pinned opponent, and what that rank is evidence of. Split out of opponents/ratings.json on purpose: the rating and the rank are two different observations of the same team, eval/panel.py refuses a snapshot where the two files disagree about `kind`, and a rank typed beside a run is exactly the hand-carry the panel snapshot exists to remove. `kind` follows docs/RATINGS_REFRESH.md: `direct` is our own submission of the byte-identical artifact, `author_current` is the author team while the pinned artifact is their newest publication, and `author_upper_bound` bounds the artifact from above -- it can prove an agent is not top ten and can never prove that it is, so it places nothing in a band. Refresh procedure: docs/PANEL_SNAPSHOT.md.
